real_freshservice_path.what_exists_today: demo/agent.manifest.json lists kb-2211 and kb-1180 with a revision string. Editing that revision is what files the change, through the Manifest Watcher (RFC 7.5).
real_freshservice_path.what_a_real_instance_would_need: A poller that GETs /api/v2/solutions/articles/{id} on the Freshservice domain in config.json, reads the article's updated_at or revision, and writes it into the manifest's knowledge entry. The Manifest Watcher then behaves identically. Docket's Freshservice client (backend/src/docket/record/freshservice.py) only writes change records today; it does not read solution articles.
real_freshservice_path.why_it_is_not_faked: RFC section 0, rule 5: do not guess vendor field names. No solution-article mapping table exists in RFC section 7, so no reader was written.
